question: What situation arises if another image is brought near after installation ends?
premises: The installation has reached its conclusion.
An image or similar object may be brought in.
It may be placed near the installed object.
inference: A special case occurs when another image is brought near after installation is finished.
uncertainties: beramādyamānītaṃ taken as compound describing brought image etc.
plain_english: But if, at the end of the installation, an image or the like is brought near it.
